verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of Cloudflare-specific private networking primitives (e.g., Service Bindings, Cloudflare Tunnel, Zero Trust private network routing) that would let internal service-to-service traffic bypass the public internet without VPC setup; only generic 'Zero Trust controls... on every request' (docs-18) and generic external Bindings (docs-10) are present, neither of which documents the specific internal-traffic-off-internet capability. Missing for 10: evidence of Service Bindings/worker-to-worker private calls, Cloudflare Tunnel or WARP-based private routing, and any devops-lead-facing documentation of VPC-free internal networking.
